title: An answer for a Mistretta-Stoppino's conjecture
summary: We study the relation between linear stability of generated linear series on smooth curves and slope stability of their associated syzygy bundles. Motivated by conjectures of Mistretta and Stoppino, we establish new cases in which linear stability implies slope stability, focusing first on generated linear series over general curves and then on curves lying on polarized K3 surfaces. In the case of general curves, we use Brill-Noether-theoretic arguments to relate the numerical conditions on the linear series to the semi-stability of the syzygy bundle.
